label: D1 with a moderate a1 preference, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass; never at GO or D2), on about 10% of D1 steps. Within D1 it tracks the policy leaning moderately toward a1: 84% of mass falls where the D1 choice logit is in [2.78, 8.07), and none where it is below -1.5 or in the extreme a1 tail above 8.07. The upcoming action is a1 in 78% of mass. Its rate falls steadily with trial number in the episode (2.6x in trials 0-9, 0 after trial 89) and it is strongest in the middle value bins (7.54-7.73). It fires a little more after unrewarded trials (rate about 0.12 vs 0.08 after rewarded ones), and it does not depend on the core pattern, the transition, or this trial's reward. D1 & choice>2.78 alone gives recall 0.85 but precision 0.24. Adding ep_trial<50 raises F1 to 0.50, and adding value bounds does no better. Many D1 steps with the same a1 lean stay silent, especially late in an episode or after long runs of rewarded a1 choices, so the feature probably encodes graded a1-leaning, not-yet-saturated confidence early in an episode rather than a clean boolean. The recorded predicate uses only observed or model-internal variables (the model's own logit and the trial number).
